findings.failure_path: Delete enough unrelated owner-package text to make the diff net-negative, add a new normative rule, and submit a source-refuted row with observed-failure: no, a valid firing path into the added rule, an arbitrary URL, and a pointer such as `README.md#nonexistent` where README.md merely exists and is non-empty. Lines 1124-1139 accept all four bars, and this line then satisfies the owner RED floor, allowing a real behavior change to self-clear without RED evidence. Case B only tests an unoffset net addition, while C/D do not test bogus-but-present evidence.
findings.smallest_fix: Do not let source_refuted satisfy the owner RED floor until the gate can mechanically bind the cited source and an existing anchor to the withdrawn obligation and exclude offset additions; minimally remove `entry[:source_refuted]` from this floor and add a regression case combining a large unrelated deletion, an added normative rule, an arbitrary URL, and a nonexistent-anchor pointer.

concern_results.conclusion: The four checks compose into a general waiver: declarations are author-controlled, any URL qualifies, any non-empty file qualifies even with a nonexistent anchor, and unrelated deletions can offset added behavioral rules.
Containment is not demonstrated. The frozen tests cover missing fields and pure net addition, but omit the decisive offset attack and syntactically present yet meaningless source/map evidence.
